name: Cinderella Perudue
original_name: シンデレラ ペルデュー
source:
The hero gets a strange message from communication club "BC" one day. In the encounter with five girls he needs to get the information to decipher the message.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1986.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天，主人公收到交友俱乐部“BC”发来的神秘信息。为了破译内容，他需要与5名女孩接触，从她们那里收集线索。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1986.html]vndbreview[/url]]
